slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the primary business objective for this planning problem?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the primary business objective and included minimizing total cost with setup and processing costs as an option.

slot_scores.name: exactly_one_piece_per_part
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Does every part need to be processed, or can some parts be left unprocessed?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked whether all parts must be processed, which covers the requirement that parts cannot be skipped, but did not ask about the quantity of pieces per part type.

slot_scores.name: reverse_conditional_part1_part2
slot_scores.rationale: The agent only asked about the forward conditional for part 1 on A; it did not ask about the reverse rule when part 1 is on B or C.

slot_scores.name: part3_on_machine_A
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask about any mandatory machine assignment for part 3.

slot_scores.name: part5_on_machine_C
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask about any mandatory machine assignment for part 5.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Exactly one piece of each of the 10 part types must be processed.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent only confirmed that all parts must be processed, not that the quantity is exactly one piece per part type.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: No reverse conditional applies when part 1 is processed on machine B or C.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the reverse conditional and omitted it from the confirmed business rules.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Part 3 has no mandatory machine assignment.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a fixed machine for part 3 and did not include such a constraint.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Part 5 has no mandatory machine assignment.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a fixed machine for part 5 and did not include such a constraint.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the exact quantity per part was only partially resolved and the reverse conditional, part 3 assignment, and part 5 assignment were unresolved.

summary: The agent confirmed the objective and several constraints but stopped prematurely, missing the exact one-piece-per-part quantity and three P1 assignment/conditional rules, which it silently assumed away.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
